name: upward facing dog
instructions: Step:1 Position yourself face down on the floor with your legs extended behind you.
Step:2 Set your hands on the floor next to your lower ribs, fingers pointing forward.
Step:3 Settle into the starting position and take an easy breath before moving deeper.
Step:4 Ease toward the stretch until you feel mild tension; keep breathing and avoid bouncing.
Step:5 Stay in a mild stretch rather than pulling farther with momentum.
Step:6 Hold the position with steady breathing, then release gently; repeat on the other side if needed.

name: assisted hanging knee raise
instructions: Step:1 Suspend yourself from a pull-up bar with your arms straight and your palms turned away from you.
Step:2 Brace your trunk muscles and lift your knees toward your chest, bending at the hips and knees.
Step:3 Brace the abdomen and keep the shoulders anchored to the support.
Step:4 Lift your legs by bracing your trunk and moving at the hips rather than swinging.
Step:5 Slow the legs before they pull the lower back out of position.
Step:6 Lower the legs slowly without swinging or losing your trunk position.

name: impossible dips
instructions: Step:1 Set yourself between two parallel bars with your arms straight and your body suspended in the air.
Step:2 Before moving, bend your knees and cross your ankles.
Step:3 Set the shoulders down and keep the elbows pointed mostly behind you.
Step:4 Bend the elbows to lower between the supports; stop at a comfortable shoulder depth.
Step:5 Choose a depth that lets the shoulders stay comfortable.
Step:6 Press through the hands to rise, then reset the shoulders before another rep.

name: push-up inside leg kick
instructions: Step:1 Begin in a push-up position with your hands just beyond shoulder width and your feet together.
Step:2 Lower your body toward the ground by bending your elbows, with your spine steady and your core engaged.
Step:3 Brace the abdomen and glutes so the shoulders, hips and ankles move together.
Step:4 Bend your elbows to lower your chest while keeping your body in one line.
Step:5 Keep the head in line with the spine as the elbows bend.
Step:6 Press back to straight arms, keeping the body line intact.

name: Cable Crossover
instructions: Step:1 Set the cable pulleys to chest height.
Step:2 Take your place in the center of the cable machine with one foot in front of the other.
Step:3 Keep a soft elbow bend and set the shoulders before moving the arms.
Step:4 Bring the handles across the front of your chest in a broad arc, keeping a slight elbow bend.
Step:5 Keep the elbow angle nearly unchanged through the arc.
Step:6 Open the arms back along the same arc without dropping the load.

name: barbell seated bradford rocky press
instructions: Step:1 Take a seat on a bench with your back straight and feet planted.
Step:2 Take hold of the barbell with palms facing down, just beyond shoulder width.
Step:3 Brace the torso and align the wrists with the forearms.
Step:4 Press the weight or handles away while keeping your trunk braced.
Step:5 Keep the wrists stacked and use a shoulder path that feels natural.
Step:6 Lower the weight to its starting height under control before pressing again.

name: band underhand pulldown
instructions: Step:1 Connect the band to a high anchor point, such as a pull-up bar or sturdy beam.
Step:2 Face the anchor point from a stable stance with feet about shoulder width.
Step:3 Sit tall and set the shoulders before drawing the handle down.
Step:4 Pull the handle down by driving your elbows toward your ribs; keep your torso steady.
Step:5 Control the band on the way back instead of letting it snap you into position.
Step:6 Let the handle rise steadily until the arms are long, then reset the shoulders.

name: dumbbell standing reverse curl
instructions: Step:1 Stand tall with your feet about shoulder width and hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your body.

Step:2 With your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps. Continue to raise the weights until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Step:3 Set the shoulders and upper arms before bending the elbows.
Step:4 Curl the weight with your palms facing down, keeping the elbows close and torso still.
Step:5 Keep the torso quiet and let the elbow bend lift the weight.
Step:6 Lower until the elbows are nearly straight, keeping the upper arms still.

name: Single-Leg Floor Calf Raise
instructions: Step:1 Stand and set your feet about hip width and place your hands on a wall or sturdy object for balance.
Step:2 Before moving, lift one foot off the ground and balance on the other foot.
Step:3 Let the ankles move freely while the rest of the body stays quiet.
Step:4 Rise through the balls of your feet, lifting the heels as high as you can without rocking.
Step:5 Keep the pelvis level as the supporting leg does the work.
Step:6 Lower the heels at a measured pace before rising again; switch sides when the set calls for it.

name: dumbbell burpee
instructions: Step:1 Begin in a standing position with your feet about shoulder width and a dumbbell in each hand.
Step:2 Before moving, lower your body into a squat position, placing the dumbbells on the ground in front of you.
Step:3 Start at a pace that lets the feet and arms move in sync.
Step:4 Move at a repeatable pace, keeping the motion smooth and your breathing steady.
Step:5 Keep the pattern repeatable as speed increases.
Step:6 Keep the rhythm for the planned interval, slowing if your form starts to slip.

name: roller hip lat stretch
instructions: Step:1 Begin by kneeling on the ground with the roller positioned under your hips.
Step:2 Set your hands on the roller for support.
Step:3 Settle into the starting position and take an easy breath before moving deeper.
Step:4 Ease toward the stretch until you feel mild tension; keep breathing and avoid bouncing.
Step:5 Stay in a mild stretch rather than pulling farther with momentum.
Step:6 Hold the position with steady breathing, then release gently; repeat on the other side if needed.

name: weighted sissy squat
instructions: Step:1 Stand and set your feet about shoulder width and your toes pointing slightly outward.
Step:2 Take a weight ahead of your chest with both hands, or place a barbell across your upper back.
Step:3 Brace the abdomen and spread pressure across the whole foot.
Step:4 Bend at the hips and knees to lower, keeping your feet grounded and knees tracking with the toes.
Step:5 Drive upward with the chest and hips rising together; keep the knees from collapsing inward.
Step:6 Stand fully, reset your footing and breathing, then begin the next descent.

name: runners stretch
instructions: Step:1 Stand and set your feet about hip width.
Step:2 Step forward with your right foot, keeping your left foot planted.
Step:3 Settle into the starting position and take an easy breath before moving deeper.
Step:4 Ease toward the stretch until you feel mild tension; keep breathing and avoid bouncing.
Step:5 Stay in a mild stretch rather than pulling farther with momentum.
Step:6 Hold the position with steady breathing, then release gently; repeat on the other side if needed.

name: cable pulldown (pro lat bar)
instructions: Step:1 Set the seat height so that your thighs are parallel to the ground and your feet are flat on the floor.
Step:2 Hold the lat bar with palms facing down, just beyond shoulder width.
Step:3 Sit tall and set the shoulders before drawing the handle down.
Step:4 Pull the handle down by driving your elbows toward your ribs; keep your torso steady.
Step:5 Pull with the elbows rather than leaning far back to move the handle.
Step:6 Let the handle rise steadily until the arms are long, then reset the shoulders.

name: inverse leg curl (on pull-up cable machine)
instructions: Step:1 Set the cable machine so that the ankle straps are at the lowest setting.
Step:2 Position yourself face down on the bench with your legs extended and the ankle straps attached to your feet.
Step:3 Line the knees up with the machine or bench edge before starting the curl.
Step:4 Bend your knees to draw the pad toward you without lifting your hips from the support.
Step:5 Keep the hips still while the knees bend.
Step:6 Ease back to the start before repeating.

name: Smith Seated Single-Leg Calf Raise
instructions: Step:1 Take a seat on the machine with your back against the pad and your feet on the footrest.
Step:2 Set one leg on the footrest and keep the other leg off the footrest.
Step:3 Let the ankles move freely while the rest of the body stays quiet.
Step:4 Rise through the balls of your feet, lifting the heels as high as you can without rocking.
Step:5 Keep the pelvis level as the supporting leg does the work.
Step:6 Lower the heels at a measured pace before rising again; switch sides when the set calls for it.

name: Pull-Up (Neutral Grip)
instructions: Step:1 Suspend yourself from a pull-up bar with a neutral grip (palms facing each other) and your arms straight.
Step:2 Brace your trunk and draw your shoulder blades toward each other.
Step:3 Begin from a controlled hang with the shoulders active rather than slack.
Step:4 Pull your elbows down and bring your upper chest toward the bar without kicking your legs.
Step:5 Avoid swinging the legs to clear the bar.
Step:6 Lower to long arms without dropping suddenly from the top.

name: Band Seated Hip Abduction
instructions: Step:1 Take a seat on a chair or bench with your back straight and feet planted.
Step:2 Loop the resistance band around your thighs, just above your knees.
Step:3 Square the pelvis before moving the working leg.
Step:4 Open the knees or legs against resistance without shifting your torso.
Step:5 Control the band on the way back instead of letting it snap you into position.
Step:6 Return along the same path at a controlled pace.

name: bear crawl
instructions: Step:1 Get onto hands and knees with your hands directly under your shoulders and your knees directly under your hips.
Step:2 Before moving, lift your knees slightly off the ground, keeping your back flat and your core engaged.
Step:3 Start at a pace that lets the feet and arms move in sync.
Step:4 Move at a repeatable pace, keeping the motion smooth and your breathing steady.
Step:5 Keep the pattern repeatable as speed increases.
Step:6 Keep the rhythm for the planned interval, slowing if your form starts to slip.

name: sled 45° leg press
instructions: Step:1 Set the seat and footplate of the sled machine to a comfortable position.
Step:2 Take a seat on the sled machine with your back against the backrest and your feet about shoulder width on the footplate.
Step:3 Set your feet firmly on the plate and keep the hips against the seat.
Step:4 Bend the knees to bring the platform toward you, then press it away through the feet.
Step:5 Stop the descent before the hips lift from the seat.
Step:6 Bring the weight or body back to its starting position without rushing.

name: isometric wipers
instructions: Step:1 Begin by lying flat on your back on a mat or bench.
Step:2 Reach your arms straight out to the sides, perpendicular to your body.
Step:3 Set the pelvis and make the turn through the rib cage.
Step:4 Keep the trunk braced as the legs move together from side to side.
Step:5 Keep the turn smooth instead of throwing the arms across the body.
Step:6 Return through center before turning to the other side.

name: raise single arm push-up
instructions: Step:1 Begin in a push-up position with your hands just beyond shoulder width and your feet together.
Step:2 Reach one arm straight out to the side, parallel to the ground.
Step:3 Brace the abdomen and glutes so the shoulders, hips and ankles move together.
Step:4 Bend your elbows to lower your chest while keeping your body in one line.
Step:5 Keep the head in line with the spine as the elbows bend.
Step:6 Press back to straight arms, keeping the body line intact.

name: weighted stretch lunge
instructions: Step:1 Stand and set your feet about shoulder width.
Step:2 Step forward with your right foot, with your spine steady.
Step:3 Settle into the starting position and take an easy breath before moving deeper.
Step:4 Ease toward the stretch until you feel mild tension; keep breathing and avoid bouncing.
Step:5 Stay in a mild stretch rather than pulling farther with momentum.
Step:6 Hold the position with steady breathing, then release gently; repeat on the other side if needed.

name: Seated Calf Stretch
instructions: Step:1 Take a seat on the edge of a chair or bench with your feet planted.
Step:2 Reach one leg straight out in front of you, keeping your heel on the ground.
Step:3 Settle into the starting position and take an easy breath before moving deeper.
Step:4 Ease the heel down and shift until the calf stretches; keep the foot pointed ahead.
Step:5 Stay in a mild stretch rather than pulling farther with momentum.
Step:6 Hold the position with steady breathing, then release gently; repeat on the other side if needed.

name: Machine Lying Leg Curl
instructions: Step:1 Set the machine to fit your body and select the desired weight.
Step:2 Position yourself face down on the machine with your legs straight and your heels against the padded lever.
Step:3 Line the knees up with the machine or bench edge before starting the curl.
Step:4 Bend your knees to draw the pad toward you without lifting your hips from the support.
Step:5 Keep the hips still while the knees bend.
Step:6 Ease back to the start before repeating.
